1
Izn e Wida Na Mil Paya Khara Hai Aas Liye
Sakina Pyasi Hai Woh Rota Ja Raha Hai Yehi Dukh Sath Liye.
Kaho Baba Se Sakina Darya Pe Jane Do.
Nahi Larney Ki Ijazat Pani Tu Laney Do.
Jo Kozay Sokh Gaye Sabhi Bachoon Ne Le Kar Hai Mere Naam Kiye.
Masooma Kaisay Bhejon Nahi Hosla Mera.
Che Mah Ka Tera Bhai, Bhai Jawaan Mera.
Kahin Aisa Na Ho Keh Dono Mar Hi Jaein Koi Na Pani Piye.
Mujhe Moaf Kar Do Bibi Khaimay Na Aa Saka.
Iss Gham Ne Mar Dala Pani Na La Saka.
Yeh Mashkeza Jo Hai Rahe Ga Sath Alam Ke Yehi Ahsas Liye.
Maqtal Mein Aa Gayi Hai Lashon Ke Darmiyaan.
Ro Deti Hai Sadaein Chacha Ho Tum Kahan.
Jala Ghazi Ka Alam Utha Kar Chal Rahi Hai Ossi Ki Yaad Liye.
Bazu Nahi Rahe Tu Ossay Gham Nahi Howa.
Chehray Pe Teer Khaye Phir Bhi Nahi Ruka.
:AAL E ABDULLAH: Jo Baha Pani Mashk Se Tu Kya Abbas Jiye.

item.text:
Reconstructed all 17 verses in Urdu script and verified that they correspond line by line with the transcription in `romanLyrics`. Updated the Urdu and Roman titles, set the direction to right-to-left, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read the ambiguous Roman “Jala” as `جلا`, referring to the burned standard. Only the selected Markdown file was edited.
